caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular composition filled with several human figures and large floral motifs. In the upper left quadrant, two pairs of people are engaged in a game resembling tennis or badminton; they are holding rackets and facing each other across a net. The figures are dressed in period clothing, with the women wearing long gowns and the men in knee-length breeches and shirts. Scattered throughout the image are large, detailed flowers in shades of pink and beige, with broad leaves and curving stems, filling the background and foreground. In the lower half of the image, a reclining female figure, also in a period dress and hat, rests among the flowers. The overall color scheme consists of brown tones for the background, with the figures and floral elements rendered in lighter shades of tan, beige, and muted pink, creating a contrast that distinguishes the characters and plants from the darker backdrop. The entire illustration sits centered on a larger blank sheet of cream-colored paper.
